description.value: Bobbie Burns Lodge is a legendary backcountry heli-skiing lodge in the Kootenays operated by Canadian Mountain Holidays, famous for massive peak-to-valley vertical runs and a fast-paced, expert-focused atmosphere. One of the original heli-skiing lodges in British Columbia, it is accessible only by helicopter as part of a booked CMH program. In summer it serves as a base for guided heli-accessed hiking in remote alpine terrain.

address.value: Vowell Creek Forest Service Rd, Parson, BC V0A 1L0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bobbie Burns Lodge is a real, actively operating heli-skiing and summer heli-hiking destination run by Canadian Mountain Holidays (CMH), with the OSM phone number 1-800-661-0252 corroborated throughout the site. The lodge is accessed exclusively by helicopter as part of booked CMH programs; no road or trail access for cyclists is indicated, and the website makes no mention of cycling, bike storage, or any cycling-related amenities. All required criteria and optional amenities default to null due to complete absence of evidence.
concerns: Lodge is accessible exclusively by helicopter as part of a booked CMH program — no road or trail access; touring cyclists cannot reach this location by bike
No street address available in OSM or on website
No cycling-related amenities mentioned anywhere on the website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable business confirmed by website. Helicopter-only access makes it practically unreachable by touring cyclists, but access limitations are a curation concern outside scope of inclusion criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: This property may be of very limited utility to the WWC cycling tourism directory given helicopter-only access, but it is a real and operating accommodation.
